rows.notes: [T057] dated floor (D-025): phase 1 of the Qingdao base declared in production on 2019-04-29, design annual capacity 4 GWh (EnergyTrend 2019-04-30, S1; page also states overall plan 10 GWh/yr - fetch-tool rendering of the text: '一期项目...设计年产能4 GWh', '总体规划年产能10GWh'). installed basis: press (design capacity of phase 1). ESCALATE: nameplate 40 likely overstated; evidence supports 10 GWh (2019 plan, S1) unless a later source shows phase-2+ expansion. rows.notes: [T057] New row (lead from data/reference/operator_sites/T004.csv, excluded there as 'no_open_source'; added because the AR shows a large operating cell-processing site). CALB AR 2025 (S2, S3): Luoyang Company is a connected person (owned 49% Jinhang Holding / 51% Jincheng Technology, the latter wholly owned by Jintan Holding), provides entrusted processing of lithium batteries for CALB under a framework agreement renewed through 31 Dec 2026, 'has a mature and stable production line', and was one of CALB's five largest suppliers; actual 2025 processing transactions ~RMB3,575.80 million (annual cap RMB3,800m). This is the historic AVIC Lithium (中航锂电) Luoyang base; it is a separate legal entity from CALB Group, so no double-count with the CALB rows (CALB Luoyang is not in the DB; the CATL Luoyang row is a different company). Capacity not disclosed in the AR; nameplate/installed/start_year/chemistry/coordinates left null (older press, not opened/verified, cites ~10 GWh for Luoyang in 2019-2021 and a 1.5 GWh phase-3 EPC case; not used). Status rests on the AR statement of an operating line and RMB3.6bn of 2025 processing fees (no 'cell' wording beyond 'lithium batteries' processing; assumed cell-level production). Freshness: AR published 2026-04-29.
